metadata.name: Basic Unicode Character Mapping
metadata.description: Mapping a Unicode character to its link representation
metadata.author: LinksPlatform Team

input.description: Map the character 'A' (Unicode U+0041, decimal 65) to a link

rules: Each Unicode character maps to a unique link ID
The link ID typically corresponds to the Unicode code point value
Character links are preallocated in the Unicode map
notes: The Unicode map must be initialized before character mapping operations.
